newsitem.title: UK: S&P assigns BBB to MedPartners Inc $300 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BBB to MedPartners Inc $300 mln notes.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it assigned its BBB rating to MedPartners Inc's $300 million senior notes due 2006.
The company's corporate credit rating and the rating on its $100 million senior notes due 2003 have also been affirmed at BBB, S&P said in a statement.

"MedPartners' investment-grade ratings reflect the company's important positions in diverse businesses and conservative financial policies, offset by a short record of success and aggressive growth strategies," S&P said.

S&P said the outlook was stable. It said it expected MedPartners to maintain its financial conservatism, while integrating and further expanding operations in a challenging and dynamic business environment.
"The challenges of controlling and further growing a $4.6 billion company that was founded only four years ago is formidable," said S&P.
"Additionally, the company is susceptible to reimbursement changes, with several physician practice management markets experiencing actual declines in reimbursement."
"Moreover, competition is increasing, as the highly fragmented physician marketplace is consolidating rapidly," the rating agency said.
"Importantly, funds from operations to lease-adjusted debt is expected to be about 40 percent absent one-time merger related charges, providing some flexibility," S&P said.
